title: Express a repeated routine
instructions: Use the frequency anchor to select the viewpoint.

parts.prompt: Every Friday, the librarian ___ the returned books before the reading club arrives.

choice_rationales.A: Present continuous would present a temporary action around now, not the stated weekly routine.
choice_rationales.B: Present perfect does not express the repeated timetable as directly as simple present here.
choice_rationales.C: Sorts matches the regular routine signalled by every Friday.
choice_rationales.D: Past continuous needs a past reference point and does not fit the ongoing schedule.

parts.hint: Every Friday signals a regular repeated action.
parts.correct_explanation: Simple present expresses the librarian's recurring Friday routine.
